name: Home Depot Outbreak
premise: You are inside a Home Depot in a dense city when a zombie outbreak starts. A police station is across the street and a military base is two miles away. Each day is one more day of survival.
tone: tense, practical survival rules, real facts

name: Floor 14
premise: You live on floor fourteen of an apartment tower when the city loses power and something starts moving in the stairwells. Each episode is the next night.
tone: slow dread, rules, one wrong detail per episode

name: Dead Zone Road Trip
premise: You are driving across a desert highway when every phone and radio goes silent and the towns you pass are empty. Each episode is the next stop.
tone: mystery, survival choices, real desert survival facts
